# Engineering Onboarding

Welcome to Northwind Systems. Your first week is structured around three
goals: get your development environment working, ship one small change to
production, and meet every person on your immediate team. Your onboarding
buddy is assigned on day one and is your default question-asker for the
first month.

Laptop provisioning happens through IT on your start date. You will receive
a MacBook Pro M3 with 36GB of memory as standard. Requests for Linux
workstations require director approval and take roughly two weeks to
fulfill because the hardware is not kept in stock.

All employees must complete the annual security awareness training within
30 days of their start date. Failure to complete the training results in
temporary suspension of VPN access until it is finished. The training takes
approximately 45 minutes and is available in the learning portal.

This document is maintained by the People Operations team. For questions,
contact peopleops@northwind.example. Last reviewed March 2026.
